ui.title: The Divine Ledger
ui.subtitle: One hero. One road. Occasional divine interference.
ui.localOnly: Private chronicle · saved in this browser
ui.clockRule: World: visible 1× · away 0.1× · GP always real time
ui.statsHint: Effective = base + equipped gear, after combat caps. Raw totals include gear, before caps. HP and damage in points; chance and speed in %.
ui.compact: Compact names (expand for the full account)
ui.autoequip: The hero chooses equipment by perceived power. Your blessings influence, never directly equip.
ui.emptyBag: Ten spaces. An optimistic amount of luggage.
ui.itemBlessHint: Blessing raises perceived power ×1.5 and protects against sale, drop and death loss. Available outside combat; permanent, no unlock control.
ui.flowRate: Next GP in {seconds} s · +1 per {rate} real seconds (unless all storage is full)
ui.chargeHint: Requires 100 free capacity. Partial redemption is refused; no credit is lost.
ui.blessingHint: Base: heal 25% max HP. Outside combat: +1 good alignment. Miracle upgrades and equipped effects multiply strength. In combat, queued for next tick.
ui.smiteHint: Base in combat: 20% enemy max HP, bypassing defense/evasion. Outside combat: lose 10% hero max HP (can kill), +5 quest progress, −1 alignment. Strength scales with miracles and gear.
ui.voiceHint: Exact keywords: fight, flee, rest, town, dig. Obey chance {chance}%. Unknown text is ignored without cost; commands are hints, not direct control.
ui.templeDeferred: Temple construction belongs to phase 2 and is not implemented. Bricks are collected, not spent.
ui.waiting: The hero is composing the next entry. Life proceeds without a Start button.
ui.logHint: Live combat retains the newest 400 events. Scroll up to read; following resumes near the bottom. Offline fights are summarized, not replayed.
ui.actionAccepted: Intervention recorded. The diary has the outcome.
ui.actionUnavailable: Action unavailable: loading, catch-up, or another tab owns the chronicle.
ui.readonly: Read-only: another tab owns this hero. No simulation or spending occurs here. Close the owning tab, then reload to claim the chronicle.
ui.errorAdvice: Writes stop on a storage or save error. Do not clear site data: preserve the original save (godville.session.v1 and any .corrupt backup) before troubleshooting. Check storage permission and close competing tabs, then reload.
ui.progress: {done} / {total} real seconds accounted. No elapsed-time cap; controls wait until accounting finishes.
ui.footer: Client-only prototype. No account, server or cloud backup. Hero and combat balance are not yet calibrated.
ui.departedItem: an item no longer in my possession
phase.town: Taking care of business in town
upgrade.capacityHint: +25 maximum GP per level; no free refill.
upgrade.flowHint: +1 regeneration multiplier per level (base ×1). Earned fractional credit is retained.
upgrade.miracleHint: +10% base miracle strength per level, then equipped multipliers.
upgrade.clarityHint: +10 percentage points to Voice obedience per level; maximum 100%.
reject.dead: The hero is dead. Wait for resurrection.
reject.upgrade_cap: This upgrade is already at its prototype cap.
reject.insufficient_room: Make room for all 100 GP before redeeming a charge.
reject.in_combat: Item blessings are available outside combat only.
reject.unknown_item: That item is no longer in the inventory.
reject.already_blessed: That item is already blessed and protected.
quest.0: Return the town’s borrowed sense of urgency
quest.2: Find the end of a very short long story
quest.4: Prove that the road goes somewhere
diary.phase.1: Now: {phase}. I have promoted this to a plan.
diary.phase.4: Filed under {phase}. Filed badly, but filed.
diary.quest_taken.1: My new commission: {quest}. The ink smells expensive.
diary.quest_taken.2: Signed up to {quest}. I should read before signing.
diary.quest_taken.3: The noticeboard recommends: {quest}. It has never been outside.
diary.quest_taken.4: Work found: {quest}. My retirement remains theoretical.
diary.quest_paid.0: Finished ‘{quest}’: {gold} gold, {xp} XP, {faith} Faith. A profitable misunderstanding.
diary.quest_paid.1: ‘{quest}’ paid {gold} gold, {xp} XP and {faith} Faith. Receipt requested.
diary.quest_paid.2: Commission settled: {quest}. Collected {gold} gold, {xp} XP, {faith} Faith.
diary.quest_paid.3: For ‘{quest}’, they handed over {gold} gold, {xp} XP and {faith} Faith. Suspiciously promptly.
diary.quest_paid.4: Closed the file on ‘{quest}’: +{gold} gold, +{xp} XP, +{faith} Faith.
diary.level.0: Level {level}! I feel eight HP more qualified.
diary.level.1: Reached level {level}. The monsters have not been notified.
diary.level.2: Promoted to level {level}. Still carrying my own luggage.
diary.level.4: My experience now says level {level}. My judgment declines to comment.
diary.migration.0: Moved from {from} to {to}. Bigger monsters, better pies, presumably.
diary.migration.2: {from} is behind me. {to} has yet to learn my reputation.
diary.migration.3: Trading {from} for {to}. The road charged no commission.
diary.migration.4: New address: {to}. Previous creditors may inquire at {from}.
diary.return.0: Heading home because of {reason}. A strategic retreat with receipts.
diary.return.1: {reason} suggests a town visit. For once we agree.
diary.return.2: Turning back on account of {reason}. Dignity travels light.
diary.return.3: Homeward bound: {reason}. This is logistics, not cowardice.
diary.return.4: {reason} has won the argument. Back to town.
diary.encounter.0: Met a level {level} {monster}. It declined to shake hands.
diary.encounter.1: A level {level} {monster} blocked the road. Toll negotiation begins.
diary.encounter.2: Introduced myself to a level {level} {monster}. Poor opening move.
diary.encounter.3: The local welcoming committee is a level {level} {monster}.
diary.encounter.4: Found a level {level} {monster}. It appears to have found me first.
diary.flee.0: {success, select, yes {Escaped. I call that a speed trial.} other {Failed to escape. Apparently we are still discussing this.}}
diary.flee.1: {success, select, yes {My legs successfully overruled my courage.} other {My exit application was denied.}}
diary.flee.2: {success, select, yes {Withdrew from the argument at speed.} other {Retreat postponed by the other party.}}
diary.flee.3: {success, select, yes {Lived to misdescribe this later.} other {Tried running. The road was not on my side.}}
diary.flee.4: {success, select, yes {A tactical disappearance, flawlessly executed.} other {Still here. The escape plan needs revisions.}}
diary.combat_end.0: Against {monster}: {outcome}, after {seconds} seconds. The numbers have spoken.
diary.combat_end.1: {seconds} seconds with {monster} ended in {outcome}. No handshake followed.
diary.combat_end.2: Filed the {monster} incident: {outcome}; {seconds} seconds of effort.
diary.combat_end.4: The dispute with {monster} lasted {seconds} seconds. Ruling: {outcome}.
diary.loot.0: {accepted, select, yes {Kept {item}. My luggage has acquired an opinion.} other {Left {item} behind. The road may have it.}}
diary.loot.1: {accepted, select, yes {Collected {item}. A triumph of possession over sense.} other {Declined {item}. A rare moment of restraint.}}
diary.loot.2: {accepted, select, yes {{item} is mine now. Terms were not discussed.} other {{item} did not make the luggage shortlist.}}
diary.loot.3: {accepted, select, yes {Found room for {item}. My back lodged a complaint.} other {Passed over {item}. Even I have standards.}}
diary.loot.4: {accepted, select, yes {Acquired {item}. It may yet become a personality.} other {Abandoned {item} to a promising roadside career.}}
diary.find.1: Added {amount} {kind} to the accounts. No witnesses required.
diary.find.2: Discovered {amount} {kind}. My financial strategy is walking.
diary.find.3: {amount} {kind}, just lying there. A generous accounting error.
diary.find.4: Collected {amount} {kind}. Declared it a small miracle.
diary.diary.0: Walked until the scenery began repeating its excuses.
diary.diary.1: Asked the road for directions. It remained admirably straight-faced.
diary.diary.2: Practised looking experienced. Tripped over a preliminary obstacle.
diary.diary.3: Counted my blessings. Asked for a second opinion.
diary.diary.4: Nothing attacked me. Trying not to take it personally.
diary.town_service.0: Sold {sold} things for {gold} gold. Bought {item}. Commerce survives me.
diary.town_service.1: Town accounts: {sold} sales, {gold} gold earned, purchase: {item}.
diary.town_service.2: The merchant took {sold} things and paid {gold} gold. Left with {item}.
diary.town_service.3: Converted {sold} possessions to {gold} gold. New investment: {item}.
diary.town_service.4: Market visit: sold {sold}, earned {gold} gold, bought {item}. Haggling was mostly sighing.
diary.resurrect.0: Returned to life, less {gold} gold and {item}. Death charges handling fees.
diary.resurrect.1: Resurrection complete. Missing {gold} gold and {item}. Customer service unavailable.
diary.resurrect.2: Back among the living. The afterlife kept {gold} gold and {item}.
diary.resurrect.3: Death was temporary. Losing {gold} gold and {item} was not.
diary.resurrect.4: Filed a return from the afterlife. Cost: {gold} gold and {item}.
diary.voice_effect.0: Acted on ‘{intent}’. Recorded effect: {amount}. Divine instructions lack footnotes.
diary.voice_effect.1: Tried ‘{intent}’; effect {amount}. Blame may be directed upward.
diary.voice_effect.2: The ‘{intent}’ suggestion produced {amount}. I have documented my compliance.
diary.voice_effect.3: Implemented ‘{intent}’, effect {amount}. Interpretation remains my specialty.
diary.voice_effect.4: Followed ‘{intent}’. Outcome measure: {amount}. Heaven can audit that.
diary.miracle.0: {kind}: {queued, select, yes {queued for the next combat tick} other {{amount} HP applied}}. Heaven has noticed.
diary.miracle.1: Received a {kind}. {queued, select, yes {Delivery pending next tick.} other {The account moved by {amount} HP.}}
diary.miracle.2: A {kind} appeared on my statement. {queued, select, yes {Awaiting next-tick settlement.} other {Amount: {amount} HP.}}
diary.miracle.3: Heaven authorized {kind}: {queued, select, yes {queued} other {{amount} HP}}. I was not consulted.
diary.miracle.4: Divine intervention: {kind}, {queued, select, yes {to be processed next tick} other {{amount} HP processed}}.
diary.voice.0: Heard ‘{keyword}’. {obeyed, select, yes {Decided to try it.} other {Decided it meant lunch.}}
diary.voice.1: A voice said ‘{keyword}’. {obeyed, select, yes {Filed it under instructions.} other {Filed it under weather.}}
diary.voice.2: ‘{keyword}’, said the sky. {obeyed, select, yes {I will give it a go.} other {I respect its right to an opinion.}}
diary.voice.3: Heaven suggested ‘{keyword}’. {obeyed, select, yes {Suggestion accepted.} other {Suggestion politely lost.}}
diary.voice.4: Incoming message: ‘{keyword}’. {obeyed, select, yes {Understood well enough to act.} other {The clouds must be talking to someone else.}}
diary.upgrade.0: Heaven bought {upgrade} level {level} for {cost} Faith. My belief has a budget.
diary.upgrade.1: {cost} Faith invested in {upgrade} level {level}. Returns expected upstairs.
diary.upgrade.2: The divine office now has {upgrade} level {level}. Invoice: {cost} Faith.
diary.upgrade.4: {upgrade} advanced to {level}. My deity is {cost} Faith better equipped.
diary.charge_used.0: A heavenly reserve released {amount} GP. Even gods have savings accounts.
diary.charge_used.1: Redeemed a charge for {amount} GP. Divine liquidity restored.
diary.charge_used.2: {amount} GP moved from reserves to the working account.
diary.charge_used.3: The accumulator contributed {amount} GP. Sensible celestial bookkeeping.
diary.charge_used.4: Reserve withdrawal: {amount} GP. No overdraft required.
diary.item_blessed.0: {item} received a blessing. I am contractually fond of it now.
diary.item_blessed.1: Heaven protected {item}. The merchant looks disappointed.
diary.item_blessed.2: {item} is divinely insured. I should be so lucky.
diary.item_blessed.3: A permanent blessing on {item}. No resale clause.
diary.item_blessed.4: {item} has heavenly approval. My judgment has adjusted accordingly.
diary.coda.2: No bard was available for comment.
diary.coda.4: Further enquiries may wait until dinner.
diary.coda.5: The official version will be shorter.
diary.coda.6: My biographer can improve this later.
diary.coda.7: A footnote would only encourage it.
diary.coda.12: My sandals have declined an interview.
diary.coda.13: History may round the numbers upward.
diary.coda.14: I expected a more generous expense policy.
diary.coda.15: There is probably a lesson in this.
diary.coda.16: I shall omit the awkward parts in town.
diary.coda.17: The margins of this diary remain unconvinced.
diary.coda.18: Another entry for the pension application.
diary.coda.19: The prophecy did not specify refreshments.
diary.coda.20: Witnessed by a completely neutral pebble.
